estimator.name: utf8-byte4-v1
estimator.definition: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4) per unique repository source, summed after de-duplication
estimator.material_saving_rule: pre_estimate - post_estimate must exceed pre_uncertainty + post_uncertainty

process_envelope.scope: Repository-owned mandatory initial_reads selected by the accepted profile. Live GitHub state, PR diff bytes and other per-candidate dynamic sources remain mandatory but are held outside this corpus budget because CTX does not control their size.

worker.rationale: Calibrate from the exact CTX-03 candidate snapshot, then allow 20% bounded protocol-growth headroom.

repair_worker.rationale: Calibrate repository-owned initial reads only; exact FAIL/PR/evidence are dynamic mandatory inputs and are reported separately.

reviewer.rationale: Calibrate repository-owned initial reads only; candidate diff/live PR are dynamic mandatory inputs and remain outside the static corpus budget.

planner_gate.rationale: Calibrate the accepted planner starting pack and retain 20% bounded headroom.

docsync.rationale: Calibrate repository-owned DocSync starting sources; live accepted PR/review/merge data remains dynamic and mandatory.

h1_local_executor.rationale: Keep the deliberately narrow local-executor repository corpus bounded without assigning semantic Worker authority.

same_snapshot_measurement.snapshot_contract: All pre/post file bytes are read from the same checked-out candidate snapshot. Pre-CTX routing is reconstructed from the pre-CTX Worker/Reviewer rule family: AGENTS + ROADMAP + exact WP + Worker Review Protocol + full direct accepted predecessor evidence. Post-CTX routing is the accepted role profile plus validated capsule navigation. Sources that remain binding in both designs are held constant. Dynamic live GitHub/diff inputs are mandatory but excluded from the delta.
